itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.title: Submit a URL to YaCy (Single Page)
itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.snippet:
The local YaCy peer queues that exact URL with crawl depth zero, so linked pages are not automatically followed.
After processing, the page may appear on the yacy.space search homepage and may be shared through the YaCy network.
